author: JetroTheBadOmen
title: Promotion Matches Ruin the Game
content: Go back to the old ranking system. Promotion matches ruin the fun in the game and kills any incentive to rank up. I’ve played this game since the start, back in 2018, and I’ve enjoyed it throughout all these years. It’s a very fun game. Promotion matches only encourages hiding and camping and puts you against the sweats, making it very punishing to get through. It’s just another Ultimate Royale. If you avoid promotion matches, you just cap out at Crown 1 and get stuck there until the season resets.
